connector.name: Secretcarousel
connector.registryDescription: Agent-first secrets vault. Store, rotate, and share credentials from chat. 16 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.secretcarousel.com over server sent events, also runs locally from the npm package secretcarousel. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jyswee account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token using your SecretCarousel API key: 'Bearer sc_...'. Optional: without one the server starts in onboarding mode and can create a vault via the sc_signup tool.

env.name: SC_API_KEY
env.description: SecretCarousel API key (sc_...). Optional: without a key the server starts in onboarding mode and can self-signup via the sc_signup tool.
